author: Intan Saraswati
text:
Ordered ala carte as we’re aiming for the better part of meat. We had oyster blade, short ribs, premium wagyu tongue, dan large intestine. Everything was juicy and great, even my 5yo daughter can chew them super fast. Beef is really a good quality (they stated it was tokushima mitsuboshi beef)
The short ribs was super juicy, we ended up reordering 3x.
Dipping sauce was also good. I personally loved the yuzu, taking it in turn with wasabi and sesame oil.

W

author: Maitte
text:
I enjoy coming here for Japanese style BBQ, Yakiniku. The price is reasonable and the meat variety  and side dished are plenty for the buffet set. For the 888 B set you can have 4 different beef options plus chicken and pork. With the 1275B set you can have all of the 1 set plus a premium beef (only 1 per 2 people) plus beef entrails, if that's your thing to enjoy eating them.
The service is attentive. And the highball drink is delicious, very smooth and balanced as they use the original Japanese whiskey 🥃. One of my favourite times is calling for table service with the chicken toy squeegee on the side of the table.

author: ME3NGY • ミンチー
text:
อีกหนึ่งร้านยากินิคุที่เป็น hidden gem ในย่านสุขุมวิทนี้ ที่ร้านใช้เนื้อ Tokushima Mitsuboshi Beef ซึ่งเป็นวากิวเกรดพรีเมี่ยมจากจังหวัด Tokushima ระดับ A4-A5 พอย่างด้วยเตาถ่านแล้วหอม นุ่มละลายลิ้นมากๆ ปกติร้านจะขายเป็น a la carte แต่วันธรรมดาจันทร์-ศุกร์จะมีโปรโมชั่นบุฟเฟ่ต์มี 2 ราคาคือ 1080+ และ 1599+ บาท และบุฟเฟ่ต์เบียร์สด Asahi ในราคา 298 บาท ทานได้ในเวลา 90 นาที เจ้าของร้านและพนักงานบริการดีมากๆ คอยเปลี่ยนถ่านกับตะแกรงให้ตลอด ถ้ามาแนะนำให้โทรจองล่วงหน้าจะดีกว่า เพราะลูกค้าคนญี่ปุ่นเยอะมากๆ

🥩 ยากินิคุ
🚘 ร้านไม่มีที่จอดรถ สามารถจอดรถได้ที่ EmQuartier จอดฟรี 2 ชั่วโมงแรก เดินต่อประมาณ 450 เมตร
🚊 สถานีพร้อมพงษ์ เดินประมาณ 450 เมตร

author: N N (Pom)
text:
นี่เป็นครั้งแรกเลยที่เราได้กินเนื้อจากเกาะชิโกกู ร้านนำเข้า Awa Kuro Beef จากฟาร์มของเค้าเองในจังหวัด Tokushima ที่ร้านมีเครื่องในให้ลองสั่งหลากหลายพอสมควรด้วย
Sirloin หอมหวานกินเปล่าๆไม่ต้องจิ้มก็ได้ Tenderloin สั่งมาลองแบบไม่ราดซอสเนื้อมาแบบชิ้นหนาประมาณ 1 ซม. แต่เนื้อสีจะคล่ำหน่อย ย่างแล้วนุ่มใช้กรรไกรตัดเบาๆขาด

author: Inggie tae
text: เนื้อนุ่มคุณภาพดีมากกกกกก ไม่มีกลิ่นคาว/กลิ่นเหม็นๆเลย ประทับใจมันปูด้วยใส่เนื้อปูมาให้เต็มๆ แถมอร่อยยันน้ำจิ้มจริงๆ แถมชอบให้ทางร้านย่างให้ฟรีได้ด้วยนะ ประทับใจสุดๆ

author: A
text: Wasn’t feeling great today, so when I finally had a quiet moment I came to try the hamburger steak my friend had been raving about. The meat was incredibly juicy, the sauce had great depth, and everything was full of flavor. Even the rice was perfect. As a Japanese living in Bangkok, I feel lucky to be able to enjoy this kind of taste here. I’ll definitely be back. おいしく、とてもよかったんです！ありがとう！またきます😋

author: Nawacharee P
text:
Was an alright experience. The place was small and sticky and the seating was uncomfortable but the food was okay.

Beef quality was relatively good but nothing mind blowing. The size of the beef order is good, not too big so we can try different things. Their side dishes are small and kimchi smelled a little weird.

Staffs had interesting vibe. One guy was really nice and friendly to us, other people were kinda off-putting and were not attentive at all. We had to keep asking them to change the grill or put in more fire.

No parking at all, we parked at EmQuartier and walked over. It was a short 7 minute walk.

Quality to value is okay. It was an alright experience. Might be good for bigger party but we probably won’t be back.

author: Narinpaat Guin
text:
เนื้อดีม๊าก ที่ร้านมีแบบบุฟเฟ่ต์ด้วยนะคะ ราคาไม่แพง

author: Kanna October
text: Exquisite Japanese Beef BBQ place. The beef is sourced from their exclusive farm in Tokushima, Japan. All food are well prepared. Staffs were friendly and attentive. This is my first visit but this place have ranked up and made it to top rated Yakiniku place for me.

author: Shin Thaw
text:
I visited this place for dinner, having heard great things from friends. Located around the phrom phong area, it's a true gem for yakiniku lovers! The wagyu beef was exquisitely marbled, offering a rich flavor without being too heavy. Each cut we tried was delightful, leaving us pondering what to pick next time😊

The ambiance was warm and welcoming, with excellent service that made our dining experience even more pleasurable. The staff were attentive and provided helpful grilling tips. With the quality of beef and overall experience, the pricing felt more than reasonable! I look forward to returning with friends to explore more beef cuts and enjoy a memorable time together.

author: Pasin Humbert
text:
Overall it is alright in terms of meat quality and service. I am actually doubting if the meat (Brisket and Sirloin) is synthetic as they are too well uniformed, the fat of the sirloin is too clean cut. The color is on a pale pink side and the texture after cooking is questionable. I can only assure the diamond cut is real beef.

The staff lacks knowledge of their own menu as well.

author: J C
text:
ร้านเนื้อย่างเตาถ่าน เนื้อคือดีย์มากกก หอมกลิ่นเนื้อ นุ่มกำลังดี มีหลากหลายส่วนให้เลือกสั่ง มีแบบบุฟเฟ่ 2 ราคา 888+ และ 1298+ แค่ราคาเริ่มต้นก็คุ้มมาก ๆ เครื่องเคียงมีให้เลือกหลากหลาย แต่ถ้าอยากดื่มก็มี unlimited drink Beer 298.- ร้านไม่มีที่จอดรถ ต้องไปจอดที่ Top แล้วเดินมาที่ร้านนะค่ะ
#สายเนื้อ #อร่อยบอกต่อ

author: Chatchaya kamnerdthong
text: เนื้อ Premium Harami นุ่มอร่อย พนักงานน่ารักเป็นกันเอง ช่วยย่างให้ด้วย มันปูอร่อย

author: Kiattichai Chatchumsai
text:
I recently visited a yakiniku spot for dinner after discovering it on Google Maps. It was my first time there, and I must say, it was an excellent choice! Located in the vibrant Phrom Phong area, this place offers a fantastic selection of Wagyu and other beef cuts. The marbling of the meat was perfect, giving it a rich but not overwhelming taste. The atmosphere was cozy, and the staff provided exceptional service, offering grilling tips and ensuring a pleasant experience.😊

The quality of the meat and the ambiance justify the prices, making it a great option for special occasions or casual dining in Phrom Phong. I am already looking forward to my next visit, where I plan to try a platter with different beef cuts and possibly invite some friends to share the experience. Overall, I’d rate this spot a strong 10/10 for both food and service!✨

author: Kot Soonthronsuk
text:
It was my first visit for dinner after discovering the place on Google Maps. I'm glad I did! The ambiance was warm and welcoming, and the staff were attentive with grilling tips.

Located around phrom phong, it's a great spot to enjoy some authentic yakiniku. The Wagyu and other beef cuts had an exquisite marbling, with the aroma filling the air as they grilled to perfection.

Each cut was tender and flavorful. I was impressed by the variety on offer; it made choosing a fun experience 😊 Given the quality and the cozy atmosphere, I found the price very reasonable. I'm already planning to come back with friends to explore more cuts and sides!

author: Toe Aung
text: I discovered this spot through a friend's recommendation and have been back multiple times for dinner. The wagyu here is incredibly delicious! 🥰 The balance of fat in the wagyu cuts provides a rich flavor without being too heavy. The aroma as it grills is delightful, and there's a wide range of beef cuts to choose from, making each visit exciting. The atmosphere and service are warm and welcoming, with helpful staff ready to guide you. In the bustling area of Phrom Phong, you’ll find the quality and price satisfying for yakiniku. Next time, I’m eager to explore more diverse cuts and share the experience with friends.

author: Ckn
text: I really enjoy eating yakiniku. I’ve been to many different restaurants, and this is my third time dining at this one just this month. I’m very impressed the quality of the meat is excellent: tender and delicious, definitely worth the price. The atmosphere is similar to yakiniku restaurants in Japan. The staff provide great service, and it’s conveniently located.

author: Napaskamol Sillapachai
text: เนื้อดีมากวันนี้สั่งเป็นเซต โอมากาเซะ ดีมากคุ้มเลย รสชาติเนื้อปลื้มเลย และสั่งแฮมเบอก์ก็ดีเลยนุ่มรสชาติกำลังดี 👍☺️🤩😋

author: Gourmet Advisor
text:
The meat wasn’t particularly impressive, but it was tasty. The soup, cold noodles, and curry rice I had at the end of the meal were especially good.
The box seats on the first floor are small and a bit cramped. On the second floor, there are two tables for eight people each, which can be used as private rooms for larger groups.

author: Nuch Suppanuch
text: I like their meats but the stove was not hot enough for grilling. (It’s hot but better be hotter to make the food tastier). Service was okay. No parking space available.

author: Pitchapon Jirawongsapan
text: I recently visited a lovely yakiniku spot on a friend's recommendation for a dinner outing. My first time here, and the experience was delightful. The Wagyu had an excellent balance of fat, offering a rich yet not overpowering flavor. There were plenty of beef cuts to choose from.

author: Mana Salem
text:
If you're craving an exceptional yakiniku experience in Bangkok, look no further than 298 Nikuya Yakiniku near Sukhumvit.  Tucked away in Soi Sukhumvit 41, this gem offers a delightful escape into the world of premium grilled meats. From the moment you step inside, you're greeted with a warm and inviting atmosphere.
The star of the show, of course, is the quality of the meat. Each cut is beautifully marbled and bursting with flavor, promising a melt-in-your-mouth sensation with every bite. Whether you're a fan of tender wagyu or succulent karubi, their selection is sure to impress even the most discerning palates.
Beyond the fantastic food, the service at 298 Nikuya is truly commendable. The staff are attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable dining experience. The ambiance is perfect for a relaxed dinner with friends or a special occasion.
With its convenient location just a stone's throw from the bustling Sukhumvit area, 298 Nikuya Yakiniku is a must-visit for anyone seeking a top-notch yakiniku experience in Bangkok. Highly recommended.

author: Sompong

author: BLS
text: We loved our meal here. We made reservations on a Sunday at 7pm. The restaurant was busy. The steak melted in our mouths. We ordered ala cart and the portions were generous. I recommend the tenderloin, skirt steak and the watermelon salad. We enjoyed listening to the squeezable chickens for service.

text: A great, almost secret Japanese place.  The tiny burgers are fantastic.  Order without sauce.  The sauce is good but the beef is so delicate the sauce overwhelms it. The rice is also exceptional, whether part of a bowl or standing alone as onigiri.

text:

text: The beef was very fresh, tender, and flavorful. Nice presentation and good quality overall.

text: เนื้อย่างสไตล์ญี่ปุ่น ใช้เตาถ่าน พร้อมระบบดูดควัน เนื้อคุณภาพดีมากครับ เป็นเนื้อจากฟาร์มที่ญี่ปุ่นส่งตรงมาเลย ผมทานชุดพิเศษ และชุดโอมากาเซะ เชฟจัดให้ ได้ลิ้มลองรสชาดเนื้อที่หลากหลาย เพลินมากๆ เลย เครื่องดื่มก็มีให้เลือกครบทุกอย่าง ราคาดีงามด้วยครับ ถือว่าเครื่องดื่มถูกมากสำหรับร้านแถวนั้น มานั่งดื่มแกล้มเนื้อย่างหลังเลิกงาน หรือในวันหยุด กับเพื่อนๆ หรือครอบครัว ผมว่าฟินเลยนะ^^

author: Reyna
text:
Got the lunch buffet. It was very quiet at 2pm, so we had the staff’s full attention. The meats were of very good quality. Especially enjoyed the sirloin and diamond karubi.

Nut helped us with grilling the meat. Enjoyed my time here very much!

author: Pann Toe
text:
The quality of Wagyu left me speechless, it just melted in my mouth and even in the middle of meal , we started to feel sleepy from the good food😋
The service is prompt and quick , my favorite thing is that chicken toy we need to squeeze when we want to call a server . It was fun as well
Absolute 10/10 and should not be missing this out when you’re in bangkok

author: Sujinda Jarubhat (CuteCuteChannel)
text: I absolutely love discovering hidden gems! This place offers great value for money, with top-notch beef quality that makes you feel like you're dining in Japan. The service is excellent, with friendly and polite staff. The only downside is the limited parking space, but you'll easily find parking nearby.

text: Really nice hidden spot in an alley with PREMIUM cuts of beef. The marbling on the meat is absolutely amazing and just melts in your mouth. Service is top notch too. Highly recommend!

Update: Came for a second time for the buffet and still super happy. Everything was perfect.

text:
Great little hidden place and the meat quality is good.

The store isn’t very big but the service is great.

Would def come back and if you are around this area, make sure to give it a try

text: เครื่องในสด สะอาด ลิ้นวัวที่ห่อต้นหอมคือความคิดดีมากอะ เอาความฉุนต้นหอมมากลบความคาวลิ้น แต่ลองชิ้มลิ้นวัวแล้วก็ประหลาดใจอยู่นะ ร้านอื่นคือคาวอะ แต่ร้านนี้เขาทำไม่ให้คาว ไม่ให้มีกลิ่นได้ไง เจ้าของร้านคือแบบหล่อ ใจดี เซฟก็มารยาทดี พนักงานเฟรนลี่ไปอีก ส่วนตัวได้ลองชิมเครื่องในหลายร้านมากนะ แต่แบบว่า คาวมีกลิ่น แต่สำหรับ298 คือดี ยกให้เป็นร้านที่1ในใจ🫶💗

text: The beef was really good! I tried the buffet for 888 THB per person, and it was definitely worth it.

author: เจบี เจ
text: เนื้อร้านนี้คือดีเวอร์ พนักงานน่ารักสุด ถ่านไฟแรงดีเริ่ด เบาะนั่งสบายสุดไรสุด มีเบียร์สดด้วย รสชาติส่วนตัวคิดว่าอร่อยแต่แรงนิดหน่อย ยังไม่ทันหมดเเก้วก็มึนละ อาหารที่ชอบแล้วรู้สึกอร่อยสุดๆ ก็คงเป็นข้าวหน้าต้นหอมอะ ความไข่เยิ้มๆ ข้าวหนึบต้นหอมตัดเลี่ยน มีสาหร่ายอีก เริ่ดเกิ้นบางที บรรยากาศดี แอร์เย็น พอมีถ่ายอยู่ข้างหน้าเราปกติร้านอื่นจะร้อน แต่แบบร้านนี้ไม่เลย แอร์เย็น

author: Charlie Withayachamnankul
text:
AMAZING food yakiniku slow served on imported japanese lava rock. The temperature leads to All meats being perfectly cook, fragrant and not piping hot.

Their homemade miso with veggies is also to die for. I searched yakiniku and stumbled upon this place, holy wow, I’ll be back!

(Even their rice tastes heavenly!)

Oh, the staff who grills for you is also super nice and friendly, I feel very at home and know that Im in the good hands of the owner who respects his staff and customers, oishi! ❤️👏🏻

author: Julavasa Saardyen

author: Response CList
text: One restaurant, two personalities: the lady with glass was an angel, her excellent English was really a plus ! She served several different dishes drinks and carefully introduced them, like in Japan! But the lady without glasses seems just waked up.... and not ready for work yet, I felt guilty to bother her... overall I will not come back if with friends since the service level varies in dB level, but for personal dinning it's OK.
